# Elkhead Builders
> General contracting services in Cottage Grove, Oregon and the south Willamette Valley. Oregon CCB #261168. (541) 221-7586.

## Services
- [Kitchen Remodel](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/kitchen-remodel/): full and partial kitchen renovations. $25,000–$85,000
- [Bathroom Remodel](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/bathroom-remodel/): full bath renovations, wet rooms, accessibility. $15,000–$45,000
- [Home Additions](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/home-additions/): bump-outs, second stories, full additions. $180–$400 per sq ft
- [ADU Construction](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/adu-construction/): detached and attached accessory dwelling units. $150,000–$300,000
- [Basement Finishing](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/basement-finishing/): conversions to living space, egress, moisture control. $40,000–$90,000
- [Deck Construction](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/deck-construction/): new decks, covers, railings, stairs. $35–$75 per sq ft
- [Garage Conversion](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/garage-conversion/): garage to living or rental space. $30,000–$75,000
- [Window Replacement](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/window-replacement/): full-frame and insert replacements. $650–$1,600 per window
- [Siding Replacement](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/siding-replacement/): lap, panel, and fiber cement with weather barrier. $12,000–$40,000
- [Roof Replacement](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/roof-replacement/): tear-off, re-roof, ventilation, flashing. $9,000–$22,000
- [Structural Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/structural-repair/): beams, posts, foundations, settling. Quoted after assessment
- [Interior Remodel](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/interior-remodel/): open-concept conversions, walls, flooring, finishes. $20,000–$70,000
- [Exterior Remodel](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/exterior-remodel/): facades, entries, porches, trim. $8,000–$35,000
- [Permits & Planning](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/elkhead-builders-llc/services/permits-planning/): drawings, applications, inspection coordination. Included in project scope
